question: Should OpenClaw add a public `agents.list[].subagents.workspace` override for same-agent default subagents, or keep explicit child agent profiles plus `requireAgentId` as the supported isolation boundary?
rationale: The requested change adds public config and changes workspace file access for child sessions, which cannot be safely chosen from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep Explicit Profiles
options.body: Preserve the current model where isolation requires configured child agent profiles and `requireAgentId`, with docs or diagnostics improvements if maintainers want lower setup friction.

options.title: Add Narrow Opt-In Config
options.body: Implement `subagents.workspace` as a strict same-agent default-child override with schema, docs, doctor/security review, and focused workspace regression coverage.

options.title: Defer To Workspace Policy Design
options.body: Hold this until subagent workspace, task `cwd`, sandbox policy, and skill workdir isolation are designed together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87253.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Profiles
recommendation.body: Preserve the current model where isolation requires configured child agent profiles and `requireAgentId`, with docs or diagnostics improvements if maintainers want lower setup friction.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent security-boundary work on spawned workspace overrides is the closest history signal for this public workspace-config choice.
